correctness.rationale: The one-attempt kernel subtracts from the unrestricted gate transition law at the exponential clock the absorption-first event; the gate is open at absorption, and the residual independent clock is exponential, giving K=P-f e_1^T P. The two decaying generator modes and reflecting/absorbing boundary conditions give the displayed f_0,f_1 and 0<f_0<f_1<1. All entries of K are positive (there are surviving trajectories with either gate end state); the row sums are below one. Writing F=bar f, tr K=1+t-(1-t)F-t f_1 and det K=t(1-f_1). Thus det(I-K)=(1-t)F and det((1-F)I-K)=-pt(f_1-f_0)F. The positive determinant and trace and strict negative characteristic value at s=1-F place two distinct roots in (0,1) on either side of s. Strong Markov at position resets and the two initial tail values give exactly the positive two-geometric mixture. The strict identity S_n S_(n+2)-S_(n+1)^2=w_1w_2(lambda_1 lambda_2)^n(lambda_1-lambda_2)^2 proves the hazard ordering, and the dominant root gives the limit. The tail generating function gives m=(s-det K)/det(I-K). Total variance gives excess -2 det(sI-K)/det(I-K)^2, exactly the stated positive expression. The independent algebra check covers these quantities; the supplied verify.py and recorded verification were inspected, not executed. No claim about greater dispersion under an unspecified ordering or arbitrary initial gate laws is needed.
